title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1989: Chaos vs torchbearer (3)

section.p: Heavenly Fate Marquis nodded with a smile. Then, he looked at Su Yu and said, “Fellow Daoist April, Venerables like us might not need to fight immediately. Can I trouble you to watch over the people from my race when they’re in the field?”
Su Yu said, “You are too polite, Senior Heavenly Fate. I will only be acting on my orders.”
He had an odd feeling. Why was this guy asking him for that favor? The fate race was too mysterious. Did this old man notice something? No way, right?
Su Yu was extremely cautious, so he could detect any attempt to spy on him. Not even a powerhouse of the fate race could spy on him so easily unless it was a Master of Law.
Heavenly Fate Marquis did not elaborate. He sighed and said, “The tribulation of the myriad races is upon us. I can only hope that the coming war against the chaos race will go smoothly for us.”

Leaving those words behind, he drifted away. The others stopped observing them. The golden shuttle continued moving rapidly, passing by numerous dao centers and danger zones in the process. Before long, a dao center of the nether race appeared in the distance.
Just then, a powerful figure above the dao center threw a punch, causing space itself to explode. Intense waves rippled out, and numerous fireworks appeared in the sky.
Phenomena of dead Daofuses.
These phenomena had been around for quite a while, but they had been contained inside the concealing formation previously. With the formation broken, they were finally appearing in the sky.
Three fireworks were blooming above the dao center of the dark phantom race, with two of them being much brighter than the other. Two nether powerhouses and a dark phantom Daofuse had died there.
At the same time, three fireworks were blooming above the nether territory.
Six experts had perished.
“Damn it!”
Venerable Nether was seething with anger.
Of their seven dao centers, the nethers in four dao centers had been slaughtered. Of the entire nether race, only a barely surviving Daofuse remained.
They had rushed over quickly, but they were still a step too slow.
Venerable Desolate released his dao power, causing the ground below them to shake. He focused silently for a while before roaring, “They have just entered the Chaos Mountain! We need to pursue them!”
Looking in Chaos Mountain’s direction coldly, Venerable Nether manifested a dark river in the sky. Then, the two rushed over through the river.
The attackers were still not too far away.
As they had rushed over through a spatial tunnel, they must have arrived faster than their enemies had expected.
“How fast. Looks like we underestimated them.”
Yu Xi and the others were all soaked in the blood of the nether experts they had killed.
Dou Ke, who was panting slightly, said, “They teleported over from the Human Mountain. We didn’t manage to kill the final Daofuse.”
That was not what Yu Xi was concerned with. Rather, she was frowning as she sensed the two rapidly approaching auras.
She sounded helpless as she said, “We failed to complete the mission cleanly. So be it.”
“Pick up the speed.”

At her order, the group increased its speed. Sensing that their pursuers were closing the gap rapidly, Yu Xi tossed a jade talisman behind with a sneer while shooting forward. Moments later, two figures reached the same spot.
Suddenly, a rumble rang out.
A powerful explosion erupted.

The two Venerables were forced to move aside to avoid the explosion. Venerable Nether frowned. A trap? But the explosion didn’t seem too powerful. Suddenly, he looked up at the center of the explosion. There, a spinning mass of energy appeared.
Next, numerous roars rang out. Before the two could resume their pursuit, several ancient beasts emerged nearby before rushing toward them.
Venerable Desolate cursed and said, “They stirred the chaos power here! They know this place too well!”
As they spoke, the four ancient beasts reached them.
Some were running on the ground, and some were flying in the sky. All four were Daofuses.
“Outsiders. Die.”
There was intelligence in these ancient beasts. Sensing the rejection of the chaos dao toward these outsiders, they attacked without any hesitation despite the powerful auras the two were emitting.
They were ancient beasts. They had been around since creation.
As a battle erupted, Venerable Nether grew angrier.

A dark river manifested in the air. It shot forward, causing space itself to disintegrate in its path before wrapping around one of the ancient beasts. Instantly, the dao of the ancient beast collapsed while the beast itself was reduced into fine powder.
Down below, Venerable Desolate stomped on the ground. Just as a tiger-like beast was about to pounce on him, the ground shook before exploding right under that beast.

With a rumble, the beast was torn apart by the explosion. Two of the four beasts had been slaughtered in the blink of an eye. The two remaining beasts were alarmed, and they hurriedly roared to call for help.

Seeing what they were doing, Venerable Desolate frowned and said, “Venerable Nether, we need to pull back. There are a lot more ancient beasts nearby. If we remain, we might end up encircled by the ancient beasts. That will force us to start the war in advance.”
The myriad races were unwilling to start the war before they were even done investigating their enemies.
With an unsightly expression, Venerable Nether gnashed his teeth and said, “We’ll leave after killing these beasts.”

Venerable Desolate nodded. He did not see the need to refuse such a simple result. The two were far too strong for these beasts to handle. Less than ten seconds after the start of the battle, all four ancient beasts had died.
Right at that moment, a voice rumbled from the distant forest, “Outsiders, you’re courting death.”
Next, a dark beam shot toward them.

After crashing the black beam with his dark river, Venerable Nether said coldly, “Ancient beasts. Do not think that your faction can survive after standing in our way. Chaos Mountain alone won’t be enough to protect you from us.”
With a snort, he left with Venerable Desolate.

As for the being who had attacked him earlier, that was a pseudo king. But clearly, the two Venerables were far stronger than a mere pseudo king. The two wouldn’t have bothered to retreat if it weren’t for the fact that they were not yet ready for war. They could sense the numerous ancient beasts that were approaching them rapidly.
“How powerful.”
Inside the Chaos Forest, Yu Xi was looking in the direction of the two Venerables solemnly.
Incredibly powerful. The two had killed four Daofuse ancient beasts in the blink of an eye.

Dou Ke’s arrogance was tempered after witnessing the prowess of the two Venerables. With a heavy tone, he said, “Even in our race, very few people are strong enough to match them. Are these the so-called Venerables?”
Yu Xi said, “We return for now. These Venerables aren’t our targets. Uncle Yue Hao and the others will know what to do about them.”
With that, the group resumed their journey back.
At this time, Su Yu had arrived at the nether territory alongside the myriad race experts.
Destruction was everywhere.

Corpses and blood were the new theme of the nether territory. During Su Yu’s attack against the dragon territory, September had swallowed most of their victims. Thus, the aftermath of their attack did not look too terrible. However, things looked absolutely miserable here.
“Torchbearers!”
Several characters could be seen floating in the sky.
“No mercy from the Torchbearers.”
Su Yu frowned slightly.
A set-up?
Were they trying to blame this on the Torchbearers? What the fuck? Wasn’t this supposed to be his move? This was Su Yu’s first taste of his own medicine.
Lan Tian sent him a voice transmission, “I think we’re being made the scapegoats for what someone else did.”
March sent him a voice transmission as well, “Are you sure this isn’t us?”
March was unsure.
Su Yu didn’t even bother to answer. How was that possible? This was too obviously a set-up. But still…it would be enough to trigger the suspicion of the myriad races.

With so many myriad race experts around him, Su Yu had to keep his Heaven Gate inactive. Otherwise, he could have taken a good look at the number of attackers from Control King’s lineage. That would most certainly be a powerful group.
“Making us scapegoats. A decent idea. And they’re quite efficient. Unfortunately for them, I’m not even a Torchbearer.”

Su Yu rolled his eyes. Then again, the truth did not matter. The myriad races would definitely start talking about the Torchbearers after this. Even if they discovered that Control King’s lineage was behind this, they would still start suspecting that the Torchbearers were also hiding in the shadows.

That was not a possibility they would ignore. After all, there were already rumors claiming that the chaos race wasn’t the culprit for the previous incidents. Thus, the myriad races were already considering things from a different perspective.
What was the point of releasing Hundred Battle King when he hadn’t even bothered to attack the myriad races after regaining his freedom? Instead, he had gone after Yue Luo.

Back when Su Yu mentioned Yue Luos’ name to Hundred Battle King, he did so to provoke Hundred Battle King into looking for Yue Luo. Even that was suspicious, as why would the chaos race bother mentioning Yue Luo’s name if it was really them?
Venerable Scrape and the others started searching the area for clues.
All of them looked solemn.
They had lost two pseudo kings before even starting the war. These people were simply too decisive.
And they were also incredibly brazen.
“Chaos and Torchbearers…”
“Humanity sure is capable.”
If it weren’t for the internal conflict of humanity, the myriad races would most likely stand no chance against humanity. Fortunately, humanity was not united.
